body.x: DTS Korea(www.dts.com) introduced its cutting-edge sound technology at Korea Electronics Show 2016, which runs Oct. 26-29 at COEX.

Its sound technologies are DTS:X, DTS HEADPHONE:X, and DTS NEURAL:X. DTS:X is the 3D audio technology that can express object-oriented analysis regardless of the number of speakers or the location of the speakers for high concentration rate with its realistic sound. It is compatible with any speaker layouts, and supports DAC encoding.

DTS HEADPHONE:X is the headphone that can give the users the experience of the sound with the reference from the characteristics of original mixing studio and professional audio research institute. It provides the user interface according to the listening experience.
DTS NEURAL:X is the high-performing upmixing solution that can mix upto 11.1 channels, and it gives highly concentrated surround sound from the stereo source.

Hosted by MOTIE and organized by KEA, KES 2016 is the major international electronics and IT trade show in Korea where the convergence solution in the leading fields like electronics, ICT, semiconductors, and display and industry and IT convergence, digital broadcasting, smart education, smart factory, and e-health is displayed.
